task.title: Configure Wi-Fi on the ESP32 Temperature Monitoring System

prereq.p: Ensure that the ESP32 is connected to the computer and that the Arduino IDE is installed.

step.cmd: Open the ESP32 project in the Arduino IDE.
Locate the Wi-Fi configuration section in the program.
Enter the Wi-Fi network name in the SSID field.
Enter the Wi-Fi password in the password field.
Select the correct ESP32 board and communication port.
Upload the updated program to the ESP32.
Open the Serial Monitor to verify the Wi-Fi connection.

result.p: The ESP32 connects to the configured Wi-Fi network and begins transmitting sensor data when the connection is successful.
